definitions.explanation: So powerful or great as to be impossible to resist or compete with.

examples.japanese: {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{勝利|しょうり}を{収|おさ}めた。
{圧倒的|あっとうてき}に{人気|にんき}がある。
{彼|かれ}の{才能|さいのう}は{圧倒的|あっとうてき}だ。

notes:
{圧倒的|あっとうてき} is a na-adjective meaning overwhelming or dominant—so powerful that competition or resistance is impossible.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {圧倒的|あっとうてき}に (overwhelmingly)
- Modifying nouns: {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{勝利|しょうり}: overwhelming victory
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{人気|にんき}: overwhelming popularity
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}に{有利|ゆうり}: overwhelmingly advantageous
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{差|さ}: overwhelming gap/difference

ROOT:
{圧倒|あっとう} (to overwhelm) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix).
